title: Tech Note: 4D Business Kit Goes Flash (Part II)

historical_commentary.text: Both Macromedia Flash and 4D Business Kit are long discontinued — Flash was officially retired by Adobe at the end of 2020, and browsers no longer support it — making this note's entire technical premise obsolete; it stands today purely as a historical snapshot of early-2000s rich-client web development practices.
related_updates: Adobe officially discontinued Flash at the end of 2020, and no modern browser supports it
4D Business Kit has also been discontinued for many years
